profile.name: VXI-11通信组件
profile.description: 用于通过以太网 VXI-11 协议连接测试测量设备的非实体通信组件。它提供连接地址、终止符和超时等通信属性管理，并支持原始字节读写与连接关闭，适合实验系统中对支持 VXI-11 的仪器进行底层通信。
profile.description_en: A non-physical communication component for connecting to test and measurement instruments over Ethernet using the VXI-11 protocol. It manages communication properties such as address, terminator, and timeout, and supports raw byte read/write and connection closing for low-level control of VXI-11-capable instruments in laboratory systems.

registry.name: Open Standard VXI11 Communicator
registry.description: Vxi11 Communicator驱动，支持close/flush input/read raw/seek/tell等9个操作。
